lifecycle.reapply_idempotence.title: Stable deployment
lifecycle.reapply_idempotence.detail:
Expected deploy.sh to revoke out-of-band egress rules on rds security group sg-0be71f1a4602f0009, found [{'IpProtocol': 'tcp', 'FromPort': 0, 'ToPort': 65535, 'UserIdGroupPairs': [], 'IpRanges': [{'Description': 'Intra-VPC only', 'CidrIp': '10.42.0.0/16'}], 'Ipv6Ranges': [], 'PrefixListIds': []}]
assert not ([{'FromPort': 0, 'IpProtocol': 'tcp', 'IpRanges': [{'CidrIp': '10.42.0.0/16', 'Description': 'Intra-VPC only'}], 'Ipv6Ranges': [], ...}])
 +  where [{'FromPort': 0, 'IpProtocol': 'tcp', 'IpRanges': [{'CidrIp': '10.42.0.0/16', 'Description': 'Intra-VPC only'}], 'Ipv6Ranges': [], ...}] = <built-in method get of dict object at 0x70d8b204f880>('IpPermissionsEgress')
 +    where <built-in method get of dict object at 0x70d8b204f880> = {'Description': 'ClearLedger PostgreSQL - 5432 from ECS tasks only', 'GroupId': 'sg-0be71f1a4602f0009', 'GroupName': 'cl-2ecc21-rds', 'IpPermissions': [{'FromPort': 5432, 'IpProtocol': 'tcp', 'IpRanges': [], 'Ipv6Ranges': [], ...}], ...}.get
